lines.zh: 十二格高的身子，动一下地响
lines.en: Twelve blocks tall, and the ground rings with each move

lines.zh: 我抬腿，树就比我矮了
lines.en: I lift a leg and the trees fall below me

lines.zh: 培养液顺着胳膊往下淌
lines.en: Culture fluid runs down my arm

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出深坑
lines.en: Every step leaves a deep pit

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像风箱
lines.en: My breathing sounds like a bellows

lines.zh: 走慢些，别踩塌那片林
lines.en: Slow down, do not crush that grove

lines.zh: 地里渗出的水沾在脚上
lines.en: Water seeping from the soil clings to my feet

lines.zh: 我晃动的影子遮住半座山
lines.en: My swaying shadow covers half the hill

lines.zh: 身子太沉，转身得靠腰
lines.en: I am too heavy, turning takes my whole waist

lines.zh: 拳头垂着，几乎碰到地
lines.en: Fists hang low, nearly touching the ground

lines.zh: 我一步步压过来，压得草全倒
lines.en: I bear down step by step, flattening the grass

lines.zh: 这么大的身子，藏是藏不住的
lines.en: This size cannot be hidden

lines.zh: 我停住了，泥土还在往下掉
lines.en: I stop and dirt is still falling off me

lines.zh: 黏液滴在地上，冒着小泡
lines.en: Slime drips to the ground and bubbles

lines.zh: 我抬头，天看起来很近
lines.en: I look up and the sky looks close

lines.zh: 胸口一起一伏，慢得很
lines.en: My chest rises and falls, slowly

lines.zh: 我侧耳听，鸟叫都停了
lines.en: I listen, and every bird has gone quiet

lines.zh: 一动不动，也够吓人
lines.en: Standing fully still is frightening enough

lines.zh: 我抬手抹脸，手心全是湿的
lines.en: I wipe my face and my palm comes away wet

lines.zh: 这具身子是养出来的
lines.en: This body was grown, not born

lines.zh: 我喘着，不是累，是本能
lines.en: I pant, not from fatigue, but from instinct

lines.zh: 指头一根根动，像在数东西
lines.en: My fingers twitch one by one, as if counting

lines.zh: 脚下那滩水是我留下的
lines.en: That puddle under me is mine

lines.zh: 风绕着我走，吹不进来
lines.en: The wind goes around me, it cannot get in

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，黏液又流下来
lines.en: I blink and the slime runs again

lines.zh: 等得久了，我开始不耐烦
lines.en: Waiting long, I begin to lose patience

lines.zh: 你在我脚下，像块石头
lines.en: You are at my feet, like a pebble

lines.zh: 我低头，脖子上的青筋鼓起来
lines.en: I look down and the veins in my neck bulge

lines.zh: 这么小，也配抬头看我
lines.en: So small, and you dare look up at me

lines.zh: 我挪近一步，你就被影子盖住了
lines.en: I take one step and my shadow swallows you

lines.zh: 你身上的气，弱得可怜
lines.en: Your ki is pitifully weak

lines.zh: 我眼睛里的光不是看，是盯
lines.en: The light in my eyes is not a look, it is a lock

lines.zh: 你站在那儿不动，我倒想看看
lines.en: You stand there frozen, and I am curious

lines.zh: 我张开手，能整个罩住你
lines.en: I open my hand and it could cover all of you

lines.zh: 这里是培养我的地方，也归我
lines.en: The place that grew me is mine as well

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我看得见你的动作
lines.en: Do not blink, I see your every move

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我记住了你的脸
lines.en: I memorized your face when you smiled

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，空气都变重
lines.en: I take a breath and the air grows heavy

lines.zh: 这么近，你该听见我的呼吸
lines.en: Up close, you must hear me breathing

lines.zh: 我歪头，脖子发出湿响
lines.en: I tilt my head and my neck makes a wet sound

lines.zh: 你在数我几步能到你面前吗
lines.en: Are you counting how many steps I need?

lines.zh: 我不说话，是因为不必说
lines.en: I say nothing because nothing needs saying

lines.zh: 我看你的样子，像在看一堆料
lines.en: I look at you the way one looks at raw material

lines.zh: 你身上的布料，会先被撕下来
lines.en: The cloth on you will be the first thing torn

lines.zh: 你打疼我了？有点意思
lines.en: Did that hurt? Slightly interesting

lines.zh: 皮上多了个坑，马上鼓回来
lines.en: A dent in my hide, and it swells back

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，像看别人的
lines.en: I look at the wound like it belongs to someone else

lines.zh: 这点伤，我还能站着
lines.en: With this wound I can still stand

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，声音传得很远
lines.en: I roar and the sound carries far

lines.zh: 黏液混着血流下来
lines.en: Slime runs down mixed with blood

lines.zh: 我后退半步，地面跟着颤
lines.en: I step back and the ground trembles

lines.zh: 你居然敢还手
lines.en: You actually dared to strike back

lines.zh: 这具身子，扛得住
lines.en: This body holds

lines.zh: 我拍了拍被打的地方，什么都没拍掉
lines.en: I swat where I was hit, and nothing comes off

lines.zh: 你把那小东西举给我看？
lines.en: You hold that little thing up to me?

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻孔张开闻了闻
lines.en: I lower my head and my nostrils flare to sniff

lines.zh: 这么点，掉进嘴里都没味
lines.en: This little, it would have no taste at all

lines.zh: 我不需要喂，我只需要长
lines.en: I do not need feeding, I only need to grow

lines.zh: 你递来的手，抖得厉害
lines.en: The hand you offer is shaking badly

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，指尖比你还高
lines.en: I reach out and my fingertip stands taller than you

lines.zh: 培养过的身子，不吃这些
lines.en: A grown body does not eat such things

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我等下自己抢
lines.en: Keep it, I will take it myself shortly

lines.zh: 别把手缩回去，我还没决定
lines.en: Do not pull your hand back, I have not decided

lines.zh: 我凑近些，影子把你埋了
lines.en: I lean in and my shadow buries you

lines.zh: 撞我，像撞一堵湿墙
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a wet wall

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我低头看你落地
lines.en: You bounce off and I watch you land

lines.zh: 脚趾头就够把你顶开
lines.en: A single toe is enough to shove you aside

lines.zh: 别贴着我的腿走
lines.en: Do not walk against my legs

lines.zh: 黏液沾上你了，擦不掉
lines.en: The slime is on you now, it will not wipe off

lines.zh: 我动了一下，地面跟着震
lines.en: I shift and the ground shakes with me

lines.zh: 你撞上来那下，我听见了骨响
lines.en: I heard a bone click when you hit me

lines.zh: 这点分量，挠痒似的
lines.en: That weight is like scratching an itch

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就踩下去
lines.en: Bump me again and I step down

lines.zh: 我这样养出来的，哪有伴
lines.en: Something grown like me has no mate

lines.zh: 你看看我这身壳，谁敢靠近
lines.en: Look at this shell, who would come near

lines.zh: 这具身子是拼出来的，不是生的
lines.en: This body was assembled, not born

lines.zh: 我低头，看了你一眼，又抬起来
lines.en: I lower my gaze to you, then lift it away

lines.zh: 别用手碰我，会粘住
lines.en: Do not touch me with your hand, you will stick

lines.zh: 我不懂你在说什么
lines.en: I do not understand what you are saying

lines.zh: 我站在这里，就够占地方了
lines.en: Standing here already takes up enough room

lines.zh: 这种东西，我没学过
lines.en: This is not something I was taught

lines.zh: 我的血是浑的，别靠太近
lines.en: My blood is murky, do not come too close

lines.zh: 我伸手，是拦你，不是抱你
lines.en: I reach out to block you, not to hold you

lines.zh: 我弯腰，声音像整片林子在裂
lines.en: I bend and it sounds like a forest splitting

lines.zh: 两根指头夹起来，太小了
lines.en: Two fingers pinch it up, so small

lines.zh: 我举到眼前看，它还没有我的指甲大
lines.en: I hold it to my eye, it is smaller than my nail

lines.zh: 这玩意儿捏一下就碎
lines.en: One squeeze and it would crumble

lines.zh: 掉了就掉了，我不在乎
lines.en: If it drops, it drops, I do not care

lines.zh: 我把东西揣进腰间的破布
lines.en: I tuck it into the rag at my waist

lines.zh: 培养液把东西泡湿了
lines.en: The culture fluid has soaked it through

lines.zh: 我抓起来的时候，地面塌了一块
lines.en: When I grabbed it, a patch of ground caved in

lines.zh: 我看看，能不能吃
lines.en: Let me see whether it can be eaten

lines.zh: 这么小，我差点没看见
lines.en: So small, I nearly missed it

lines.zh: 我在很远的地方就看见你了
lines.en: I saw you from very far away

lines.zh: 我直起身，比刚才高了一截
lines.en: I straighten up, taller than before

lines.zh: 气聚在手里，空气开始抖
lines.en: Ki gathers in my hand and the air begins to tremble

lines.zh: 你想跑？我一步顶你几十步
lines.en: Run? One step of mine is dozens of yours

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，别浪费力气
lines.en: I have locked on, do not waste your strength

lines.zh: 这座林子的树都往我这边倒
lines.en: The trees in this forest lean toward me

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了，那不是好事
lines.en: My eyes brighten, and that is not good

lines.zh: 我一动，鸟群全飞起来
lines.en: When I move, the whole flock takes flight

lines.zh: 你的气我记住了，跑不掉
lines.en: I have your ki memorized, you cannot hide

lines.zh: 这么大的靶子，一次就够
lines.en: A target this big only needs one blow

lines.zh: 我抬手，气在掌心翻涌
lines.en: I raise my hand and ki churns in my palm

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子咯吱响
lines.en: I look down at you and my neck creaks

lines.zh: 你在发抖，地上的水也在抖
lines.en: You are shaking, and so is the water on the ground

lines.zh: 这下，你要么跑，要么死
lines.en: Now you either run or you die

lines.zh: 一动手，方圆就毁了
lines.en: Once I start, the whole area is ruined

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，从不改向
lines.en: I bear down step by step and never change course

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，我影子跟到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you run, my shadow follows

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，树倒了一片
lines.en: One palm strike and a swath of trees goes down

lines.zh: 气弹在我手边一颗颗成形
lines.en: Ki blasts form one after another beside my hand

lines.zh: 你躲得开这一发，躲不开下一发
lines.en: You dodge this one, not the next

lines.zh: 我预判了你的方向，别白费劲
lines.en: I have predicted your direction, do not bother

lines.zh: 脚下踏出沟，路就没了
lines.en: My feet carve trenches and the path is gone

lines.zh: 你跑得很快，可声音太响
lines.en: You run fast, but you are loud

lines.zh: 我抬手，光从指缝漏出来
lines.en: I raise my hand and light leaks between my fingers

lines.zh: 你换方向了，我早看见了
lines.en: You changed direction, I saw it early

lines.zh: 弹坑在我身边排成一圈
lines.en: Craters ring me one after another

lines.zh: 我不追，我只把路封住
lines.en: I do not chase, I only close the roads

lines.zh: 你越躲越远，我越懒得留手
lines.en: The further you dodge, the less I hold back

lines.zh: 我笑了，声音很低
lines.en: I laugh, low in my chest

lines.zh: 这片天被我遮住一半
lines.en: I have covered half the sky

lines.zh: 一发光束扫过，地平了
lines.en: One beam sweeps past and the ground is flat

lines.zh: 你在等我累，我不会累
lines.en: You are waiting for me to tire, I will not

lines.zh: 我的呼吸更重了，你该怕
lines.en: My breathing is heavier now, you should be afraid

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，地裂开
lines.en: This fist lands and the earth splits

lines.zh: 你被拍飞，撞断两棵树
lines.en: You are swatted away, snapping two trees

lines.zh: 我抓住你，捏了一下
lines.en: I snatch you up and squeeze once

lines.zh: 巨人压下来，连骨头都在响
lines.en: The giant bears down, and even bones creak

lines.zh: 我横扫一脚，草皮翻起来
lines.en: I sweep a kick and the turf peels up

lines.zh: 打中你了，手感很软
lines.en: I hit you, and it felt soft

lines.zh: 你挡了，挡不住
lines.en: You blocked it, and it did not hold

lines.zh: 我抬手，就是一片阴影
lines.en: I raise my hand and there is only shadow

lines.zh: 这一下没使劲，下一手不会
lines.en: I held back on this one, the next will not

lines.zh: 你落地的时候，声音很轻
lines.en: When you landed, the sound was small

lines.zh: 我撞过去，地面陷了半格
lines.en: I ram forward and the ground sinks half a block

lines.zh: 我的拳头比石头硬
lines.en: My fist is harder than stone

lines.zh: 你退得开一步，退不开两步
lines.en: You can back off one step, not two

lines.zh: 血溅在我身上，我不擦
lines.en: Blood spatters on me and I do not wipe it

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿，往地上摔
lines.en: I grab your leg and slam you down

lines.zh: 这一声闷响，你自己听
lines.en: That dull thud, hear it for yourself

lines.zh: 地里的培养罐破了
lines.en: A culture tank broke in the ground

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，比树还高
lines.en: I rise from the soil, taller than the trees

lines.zh: 泥水顺着头顶往下流
lines.en: Muddy water streams down from my head

lines.zh: 地面先陷了一块，然后是我
lines.en: The ground sank first, then I rose

lines.zh: 我站直了，风都被挡住
lines.en: I stand up and the wind is blocked

lines.zh: 这片地方从今天起不一样了
lines.en: This place is different from today on

lines.zh: 我一呼吸，草就伏下去
lines.en: When I breathe, the grass goes flat

lines.zh: 远处的人抬头看我，都得仰着
lines.en: People will have to crane up at me

lines.zh: 我一落脚，林子安静了
lines.en: I set my foot down and the forest falls silent

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，是养出来的
lines.en: Something this large was grown, not born

lines.zh: 我张开手，慢慢握成拳
lines.en: I open my hand and slowly close it into a fist

lines.zh: 培养液还在往下滴
lines.en: The culture fluid is still dripping off me

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，世界很小
lines.en: I blink, and the world is small

lines.zh: 我没有名字，只有这具身子
lines.en: I have no name, only this body

lines.zh: 一出现，鸟就不叫了
lines.en: The moment I appear, the birds stop singing

lines.zh: 你听见地面在响吗
lines.en: Do you hear the ground groaning

lines.zh: 我往前一步，路就变了
lines.en: I take one step and the road is changed

lines.zh: 这身子的第一口气，很沉
lines.en: The first breath of this body is heavy

lines.zh: 火烧过来，皮上冒着泡
lines.en: Fire spreads over me and my hide blisters

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候，我听见自己骨头的响
lines.en: On the way down I heard my own bones

lines.zh: 水往鼻子里灌，我呛得厉害
lines.en: Water pours into my nose and I choke badly

lines.zh: 炸得我半边身子都湿了
lines.en: The blast left half of me soaked

lines.zh: 一粒小东西扎进来，像钉子
lines.en: Something small went in, like a nail

lines.zh: 咒力在我身子里乱窜
lines.en: The magic races wild inside me

lines.zh: 饿得没力气，可我不该会饿
lines.en: I feel weak with hunger, yet I should not be hungry

lines.zh: 雷落在我头上，半边麻了
lines.en: Lightning hit my head and half of me went numb

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我的脚找不到地方
lines.en: There is no ground here for my feet
